stages.effectText: ASPD +12 when there are 2 or more enemies in attack range.

Sakiko Togawa can continuously attack , creating notes that pursue enemies; notes disappear shortly after floating out of her Attack Range; for every note on the field, Ave Mujica members ignore 4% DEF and 2% RES of the enemies (stacks up to 12 times); when skill is active, ranged attacks no longer deal reduced damage
